info.title: OneVishwam API
info.description:
REST API for the OneVishwam multi-sector marketplace (properties, vehicles,
garments, groceries, jewellery, electronics, bedding, finance).

**Response envelope:** every successful response is `{ success, message, data }`
(`utils/ApiResponse.js`); every failure is `{ success, message, errors? }`
(`middleware/errorHandler.js`).

**Authentication:** send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where a lock icon is shown.
Protected routes accept either a Firebase ID token or a legacy JWT issued by `/auth/login`.

tags.description: Registration, login, OTP password reset, profile and session management

bearerAuth.description: Legacy JWT returned by `POST /auth/login` or `POST /auth/refresh` (15m access token).

firebaseAuth.description: Firebase ID token obtained from the Firebase client SDK.

ClientRole.name: x-client-role
ClientRole.description: Selects which account collection is resolved. Defaults to `user`.

SectorService.name: service
SectorService.description: Sector module id. Use the **Try it out** box to pick one.

errors.description: Present when the failure is a per-field validation error.

Property.description: A property document (`models/Property.js`). `details` is polymorphic and depends on `propertyType`.

items.description: Binary file in multipart requests, URL in JSON requests.

details.description: Category-specific fields required by the property type.

SectorListing.description: A vehicle / garment / grocery / jewellery / electronics / bedding / finance document. Field availability varies by sector.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed (e.g. suspended account)

get.description: Returns 200 as soon as the Express app is serving. Does not touch the database.
Connects to MongoDB and pings it. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable.
Public paginated listing for one sector. Extra query parameters are applied as exact-match filters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search over the sector search fields.

post.description: Accepts JSON or `multipart/form-data` (`images`, up to 10). The status is forced to `pending` until an admin approves it.

put.description: Owner or admin only. Accepts JSON or multipart (`images`).

delete.description: Owner or admin only. Removes the document and its uploaded media.

patch.description: Owner or admin only. Implemented for `vehicles`, `finance` and `jewellery` — flips `active` ↔ `inactive`.

get.description: Read-only finance products (loans, cards, schemes) published by partners.

post.description: Up to 5 images, 1 MB each. Returns the public URLs ready to store on a listing.
Single `video` file, max 10 MB.

post.summary: Upload images and a video together
post.description: Up to 10 images plus 1 video (50 MB per file limit) in a single multipart request.

get.description:
Returns the caller's listings grouped by sector id. When `serviceType` is
provided the response is `{ <serviceType>: [ ... ] }` for that sector only.

Returns every sector collection the caller owns, keyed by sector id. With
`flatten=1` the response is a single array where each item carries `_type`.

200.description: Grouped listings, or a flat array when `flatten=1`

post.description:
Creates a document in the sector implied by `_type` (or `categoryType` /
`serviceType` / `category`). The server forces `status: pending`, caps images
at 5 and fills sector-specific defaults.

allOf.description: Extend with sector-specific fields (bhk, brand, model, etc.).

patch.description:
Owner or admin. A non-admin edit resets the status to `pending` for
re-moderation. Images are capped at 5 per listing.

delete.description: Owner or admin. Also removes the listing's uploaded images, videos, documents and brochures.

images.description: Full ordered list of image URLs.

patch.description: Same behaviour as `/listings/{type}/{id}/images/reorder`; the type is inferred.

post.description: Multipart upload of an `.xlsx` workbook plus the target `category`. Filename must follow the template naming convention.
Analytics-only endpoint; requires no authentication.

get.description: Admins see every batch; other accounts only see their own.

delete.description: Removes the batch and the listings it created.

post.summary: Add an item to a batch

get.summary: Fetch all programmatic marketplace categories & ecosystem sectors
get.description: Returns the authoritative programmatic category registry for OneVishwam. Categories are maintained in code to ensure strict schema adherence and zero drift. Supports filtering by status or featured flag, and optional live MongoDB stats.

parameters.name: includeStats
parameters.description: Attach live listing counts from MongoDB

get.summary: Fetch a single category by ID, slug, or alias

post.summary: Sync the Firebase identity into MongoDB
post.description:
Mandatory call after Firebase sign-in. Upserts the caller into `users` (or
`listers` when `x-client-role: lister`), merges records that already exist
for the same email or phone, and returns the stored profile.

firebaseUid.description: Development-only fallback when no verifiable token is present.

email.description: Development-only fallback when no verifiable token is present.

post.description:
Adds the reported seconds to `totalTimeSpent` and `sessionDuration`.
Unauthenticated calls still return 200 and are ignored, so the frontend can
fire this unconditionally.

200.description: Updated totals, or an ignored heartbeat when unauthenticated

get.description:
Resolves the account from MongoDB by Firebase UID (preferred) or email,
falling back between the `users` and `listers` collections based on
`x-client-role`.

post.description: Creates a `users` document with a bcrypt-hashed password and returns an access/refresh token pair.

password.description: Must contain an upper case letter, a lower case letter, a digit and a special character.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Limited to 10 attempts per 15 minutes per IP address.

Verifies the refresh token, rejects reuse (which revokes the stored token and
logs the session out) and issues a fresh access/refresh pair. Limited to
50 requests per 15 minutes.
Best effort — missing, invalid or already-revoked tokens still return 200.

Always returns the same generic message so the endpoint cannot be used to
enumerate accounts. The OTP expires after 5 minutes. In development,
`data.otp` is returned when email delivery is not configured. Limited to
20 requests per 15 minutes.

200.description: OTP dispatched when the account exists

post.summary: Exchange a reset OTP for a verification token
post.description: The returned `verifyToken` is valid for 5 minutes and is required by `/auth/reset-password`. Limited to 20 requests per 15 minutes.
Subject to a 60-second per-account cooldown and a 20 requests / 15 minutes rate limit.

post.summary: Set a new password using the verification token

password.description: Must contain an upper case letter, a lower case letter, a digit and a special character.

200.description: Password changed and all refresh tokens revoked

put.description:
Writes to the `users` or `listers` collection depending on the authenticated
account type. Only the fields below are writable; email and role are immutable here.
Replaces the password, revokes the previous refresh token and returns a new token pair.

newPassword.description: Must contain an upper case letter, a lower case letter, a digit and a special character.

200.description: Password changed and new tokens issued

delete.description: Hard-deletes the account document. Firebase Auth deletion is handled separately by the `cleanupDeletedUser` trigger.

post.description: Returns an admin access/refresh token pair. The first login against a database with no admins bootstraps a super-admin.
Revokes the supplied refresh token when present. Always returns 200.

get.summary: Listing counts by status and category

put.description: Accepts `approved`, `rejected` (stored as `cancelled`), `changes-required` or `cancelled`. Extra body fields fall through to the full override handler.

get.description: Returns the raw saved entries plus the referenced listings, grouped by service type.

items.description: Populated listings keyed by service type.

post.summary: Add a listing to the wishlist

item.description: ObjectId of the listing to save.

delete.summary: Remove an entry from the wishlist

get.description:
Public paginated search. Any query parameter not listed here is applied as an
exact-match Mongo filter (e.g. `bedrooms=3`). Returns `{ items, pagination }`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search over title, description, city, area, location and subtitle.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated list; every amenity must match.

post.description:
Accepts JSON or `multipart/form-data` (field `images`, max 10). New listings start
as `pending`; in-house accounts (`@onevishwam.com`, role `in_house`) are marked
priority/featured automatically.

get.description: Public. Increments `viewsCount` and returns 404 for invalid or non-public ids.

put.description: Owner or admin. Multipart `images` are appended unless `replaceImages=true`.

delete.description: Owner or admin. Soft-deletes by setting the status to `deleted` instead of removing the document.

get.description: Up to 6 approved/active properties flagged as featured.
Up to 4 approved properties sharing the city or area of the given property.
Properties owned by, or attributed to, the authenticated account.
Converts a share/place URL into an embeddable map URL used for `mapUrl`.

patch.description: Admin only. Used by the moderation queue.
Owner or admin. Flips `active` ↔ `inactive`, defaulting other statuses to `active`.

post.description: Owner or admin. Stores the PDF and sets `pdfUrl` / `brochure` on the property.
Alias of `/properties/{id}/floor-plan-images` that accepts up to 10 `floorPlans` files.
